941: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 1%.
943: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt and Immolate spells by 0.1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 0.4 sec.

965: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 2%.
966: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.
968: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by Immolate, dealing 240 to 306 Fire damage and consuming the Immolate spell.
981: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 1%.
982: Gives your Destruction spells a 2% chance to daze the target for 5 sec.
985: Gives you a 35% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while channeling the Rain of Fire, Hellfire or Soul Fire spell.
986: Gives your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, and Soul Fire spells a 13% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Gives your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, and Soul Fire spells a 26% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

1003: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 0.4 sec.

1041: Transfers 15 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

1222: Increases the effect of your Imp's Firebolt, Fire Shield, and Blood Pact spells by 10%.
1223: Increases your total Stamina by 3% but reduces your total Spirit by 1%.
1224: Increases the amount of Health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 10%.

1281: When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect that lasts 30 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 3% of total Health every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 2% of total Mana every 4 sec.

1284: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by 2%.
